why: Batch 52 part C (jobs/c3/batch52.yaml amendment 3), coverage, key row 10: 49.7's attention under the address swap on Lightning at the committed L14 (attention blocks after L: 19, 26, 33, 42), x8_write's items; no prediction: coverage run on an already-scored rule
question: no prediction: coverage run on an already-scored rule
items_rule: x8_write.eligible (the routes test's C2 scenes, O, its gate and eligibility; the first 300), as x8 ran

arms.swap: h + 2.0 (mu_k - mu_j) at the bridge word at L, k each other slot
arms.random: h + a random vector of the swap's norm (one per item and k, seed 4401)

attention: softmax probabilities recomputed from each softmax-attention layer > L's inputs (capture_queries), from the last (read) token and each question-text token; sites: last, question (mean over its tokens)
split: bridge entities sorted, shuffled with random.Random(0), first half fit
candidates: top 5 (layer, head) by locker-sentence mass (three summed) at the last token under none, mean over fit items; best = the largest mean move on fit switched pairs
necessity: the best head's o_proj-input slice zeroed at the last token / the question tokens, under none and each swap, read half, both readers

rules.follows: on read-half pairs where the lookup switched to slot k's locker under the swap, >= 1 of the five candidate heads has mean move >= 0.30 (cluster-bootstrap CI excluding 0), its mean move under the random vector on the same pairs <= 0.05, and its mean move on the non-switched swap pairs <= 0.10
rules.elsewhere: the lookup switches to slot k on >= 0.3 of the read-half swap pairs and no recorded head (every full-attention layer > L, every head) reaches a mean move of 0.15 on the switched pairs
rules.distributed: the summed mean move over the five candidate heads, or over every head of the best head's layer, is >= 0.30 while no single candidate head reaches 0.30 (beside the per-head rule)
rules.necessity: the best head (chosen on the fit half) carries the position route if, under the swap with its output zeroed at the site, the lookup's switch to slot k falls by >= 0.5 of its swap value while the identity answers (read-half swap pairs answering slot j's locker under the swap) change <= 0.10 and the recall's answer changes <= 0.10 (swap + zero vs swap); per site (last token; question tokens)
rules.not_in_full_attention: on a model with Gated DeltaNet layers, if 'elsewhere' holds: 'the dereference is not in full attention on this model' (Muse decides)
